summary: Temporary restricted and dangerous areas for unmanned aircraft flights beyond sight over the Eastern and English Channels, surface to 2,500 feet above sea level.
text:
TRIGGER NOTAM - AIP SUP 101/26 MODIFIED.
CREATION OF 16 TEMPORARY RESTRICTED AREAS ('ZRT') AND OF 4 TEMPORARY 
DANGEROUS AREAS ('ZDT') FOR UNMANNED ACFT OUT-OF-SIGHT FLIGHTS IN 
THE EASTERN CHANNEL AND THE ENGLISH CHANNEL.
THE ZRT 'LF-R400G GRAVELINE TEMPO' AND 'LF-R402D MANCHE NORD 
EXTENDED TEMPO' ARE ACTIVABLE BY NOTAM ON D-1.
---------------------------------------------------------------------
----
1)MODIFICATION ONLY IN FORCE FROM 2026 SEP 24 TO 27 :
PARAGRAPH TEMPORARY RESTRICTED AREAS - LATERAL AND VERTICAL LIMITS
ZRT LF-R401C 'COTIER SUD' TEMPO AND ZRT LF-R397 'BAIE DE SOMME NORD' 
TEMPO
LATERAL LIMITS
ADD : 'EXC ZRT 'LE TOUQUET AIR SHOW' PUBLISHED BY NOTAM WHEN IT IS 
ACTIVE' 
2)MODIFICATION ONLY IN FORCE ON 2026 SEP 25 AND 26 :
PARAGRAPH TEMPORARY RESTRICTED AREAS - LATERAL AND VERTICAL LIMITS
ZRT LF-R402A 'MANCHE NORD' LOW TEMPO, ZRT LF-R402B 'MANCHE NORD' 
HIGH TEMPO AND ZRT LF-R402C 'COTIER NORD' TEMPO
LATERAL LIMITS 
ADD : 'EXC ZRT 'LES AILES DE GRAND CALAIS' PUBLISHED BY NOTAM WHEN 
IT IS ACTIVE'
---------------------------------------------------------------------
-
THIS AIP SUP IS AVBL AT WWW.SIA.AVIATION-CIVILE.GOUV.FR
